baseCohortDefinition.name: Female patients with PNC encounters during period

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e INNER JOIN person p ON e.patient_id = p.person_id WHERE e.encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = 'fa6f3ff5-b784-43fb-ab35-a08ab7dbf074') AND e.encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND p.gender = 'F' AND e.voided = 0

SELECT o.value_text FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 1646 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.value_text FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'ef1f4c7a-2b90-4412-83bb-87ae8094ce4c') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT CONCAT(IFNULL(pa.address5,''), ', ', IFNULL(pa.address4,'')) FROM person_address pa WHERE pa.person_id = :patientId AND pa.preferred = 1 AND pa.voided = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, (SELECT MAX(encounter_datetime) FROM encounter WHERE patient_id = :patientId AND encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = 'fa6f3ff5-b784-43fb-ab35-a08ab7dbf074') AND encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0), (SELECT MAX(obs_datetime) FROM obs WHERE person_id = :patientId AND concept_id = 1732 AND obs_datetime >= :startDate AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0)) <= 6 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END

SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, (SELECT MAX(encounter_datetime) FROM encounter WHERE patient_id = :patientId AND encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = 'fa6f3ff5-b784-43fb-ab35-a08ab7dbf074') AND encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0), (SELECT MAX(obs_datetime) FROM obs WHERE person_id = :patientId AND concept_id = 1732 AND obs_datetime >= :startDate AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0)) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END

SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(WEEK, (SELECT MAX(encounter_datetime) FROM encounter WHERE patient_id = :patientId AND encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = 'fa6f3ff5-b784-43fb-ab35-a08ab7dbf074') AND encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0), (SELECT MAX(obs_datetime) FROM obs WHERE person_id = :patientId AND concept_id = 1732 AND obs_datetime >= :startDate AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0)) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
